2.t: those who humble themselves in prayer

6.t: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame
6.tr: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aimaanuhum fa-innahum ghairu maloomeen

7.t: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors
7.tr: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa-ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon

8.t: ˹the believers are also˺ those who are true to their trusts and covenants

9.t: and those who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers

10.t: These are the ones who will be awarded

11.t: Paradise as their own. They will be there forever
11.tr: Allazeena yarisoonal Firdawsa hum feehaa khaalidoon

12.t: And indeed, We created humankind from an extract of clay
12.tr: Wa-laqad khalaqnal insaana min sulaalatim min teen

13.t: then placed each ˹human˺ as a sperm-drop in a secure place
13.tr: Summa ja'alnaahu nutfatan fee qaraarim makeen

14.t: then We developed the drop into a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then developed the clot into a lump ˹of flesh˺, then developed the lump into bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, then We brought it into being as a new creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators
14.tr: Summa khalaqnan nutfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqnal 'alaqata mudghatan fakhalaq-nal mudghata 'izaaman fakasawnal 'izaama lahman summa anshaanaahu khalqan aakhar; fatabaarakal laahu ahsanul khaaliqeen

15.t: After that you will surely die

16.t: then on the Day of Judgment you will be resurrected

17.t: And indeed, We created above you seven levels ˹of heaven˺. We are never unmindful of ˹Our˺ creation
17.tr: Wa-laqad khalaqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraaa'iqa Wa-maa kunnaa 'anil khalqi ghaafileen

18.t: We send down rain from the sky in perfect measure, causing it to soak into the earth. And We are surely able to take it away
18.tr: Wa-anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa-askannaahu fil ardi Wa-innaa 'alaa zahaabim bihee laqaa-diroon

19.t: With it We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are abundant fruits, and from which you may eat
19.tr: Fa-anshaanaa lakum bihee Jannaatim min nakheelinw Wa-a'naab; lakum feehaa fawaakihu kaseeratunw Wa-minhaa taakuloon

20.t: as well as ˹olive˺ trees which grow at Mount Sinai, providing oil and a condiment to eat
20.tr: Wa-shajaratan takhruju min Toori Sainaaa'a tambutu bidduhni Wa-sibghil lil-aakileen

21.t: And there is certainly a lesson for you in cattle, from whose bellies We give you ˹milk˺ to drink, and in them are many other benefits for you, and from them you may eat
21.tr: Wa-inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibrah; nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihaa Wa-lakum feehaa manaafi'u kaseeratunw Wa-minhaa taakuloon

22.t: And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships

23.t: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people. He declared, “O my people! Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
23.tr: Wa-laqad arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaa qawmi'budul laaha maa lakum min ilahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

24.t: But the disbelieving chiefs of his people said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you, who wants to be superior to you. Had Allah willed, He could have easily sent down angels ˹instead˺. We have never heard of this in ˹the history of˺ our forefathers
24.tr: Faqaalal mala'ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yureedu aien yatafaddala 'alaikum Wa-law shaaa'al laahu la-anzala malaaa'ikatam maa sami'naa bihaazaa feee aabaaa'inal awwaleen

25.t: He is simply insane, so bear with him for a while.”
25.tr: In huwa illaa rajulum bihee jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihee hattan heen

26.t: Noah prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”

27.t: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes and directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts ˹with water˺, take on board a pair from every species along with your family—except those against whom the decree ˹to drown˺ has already been passed. And do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”
27.tr: Fa-awhainaaa ilaihi anis na'il fulka bi-a'yuninaa Wa-wahyinaa fa-izaa jaaa'a amrunaa Wa-faarat tannooru fasluk feehaa min kullin zawjainis naini Wa-ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alaihil qawlu minhum Wa-laa tukhaat-ibnee fil lazeena zalamooo innaahum mughraqoon

28.t: Then when you and those with you have settled in the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”
28.tr: Fa-izas tawaita ata Wa-mam ma'aka 'alal fulki faqulil hamdu lillaahil lazee najjaanaa minal qawmiz zalimeen

29.t: And pray, “My Lord! Allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best accommodator.”
29.tr: Wa-qur Rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakanw Wa-Anta khairul munzileen

30.t: Surely in this are lessons. And We ˹always˺ put ˹people˺ to the test
30.tr: Inna fee zaalika la-Aayaatinw Wa-in kunnaa lamubtaleen

31.t: Then We raised another generation after them
31.tr: Summaa anshaana mim ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen

32.t: and sent to them a messenger from among themselves, ˹declaring,˺ “Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
32.tr: Fa-arsalnaa feehim Rasoolam minhum ani 'budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

33.t: But the chiefs of his people—who disbelieved, denied the meeting ˹with Allah˺ in the Hereafter, and were spoiled by the worldly luxuries We had provided for them—said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you. He eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink
33.tr: Wa-qaalal mala-u min qawmihil lazeena kafaroo Wa-kazzaboo bi-liqaaa'il Aakhirati Wa-atrafnaahum fil hayaatid dunyaa maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yaakulu mimmaa taakuloona minhu Wa-yashrabu mimmaa tashraboon

34.t: And if you ˹ever˺ obey a human like yourselves, then you would certainly be losers
34.tr: Wa-la'in at'atum basharam mislakum innakum izal lakhaasiroon

35.t: Does he promise you that once you are dead and reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth ˹alive˺
35.tr: A-Ya'idukum annakum izaa mittum Wa-kuntum turaabanw Wa-izaaman annakum mukhrajoon

36.t: Impossible, simply impossible is what you are promised

37.t: There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die, others are born, and none will be resurrected
37.tr: In hiya illaa hayaatunad dunyaa namootu Wa-nahyaa Wa-maa nahnu bimab'ooseen

38.t: He is no more than a man who has fabricated a lie about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”
38.tr: In huwa illaa rajulunif taraa 'alal laahi kazibanw Wa-maa nahnuu lahoo bimu'mineen

39.t: The messenger prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”

40.t: Allah responded, “Soon they will be truly regretful.”

41.t: Then the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them with justice, and We reduced them to rubble. So away with the wrongdoing people
41.tr: Fa-akhazat-humus saihatu bilhaqqi faja'alnaahum ghusaaa'aa; fabu;dal lilqaw-miz zaalimeen

42.t: Then We raised other generations after them
42.tr: Summa anshaanaa mim ba'dihim quroonan aakhareen

43.t: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it
43.tr: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa Wa-maa yastaakhiroon

44.t: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to his people, they denied him. So We destroyed them, one after the other, reducing them to ˹cautionary˺ tales. So away with the people who refuse to believe
44.tr: Summa arsalnaa Rusulanaa tatraa kulla maa jaaa'a ummatar Rasooluhaa kazzabooh; fa-atba'naa ba'dahum ba'danw Wa-ja'alnaahum ahaadees; fabu'dal liqawmil laa yu'minoon

45.t: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and compelling proof
45.tr: Summa arsalnaa Moosaa Wa-akhaahu Haaroona bi-Aayaatinaa Wa-sultaanim mubeen

46.t: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a tyrannical people
46.tr: Ilaa Fir'awna Wa-mala'ihee fastakbaroo Wa-kaanoo qawman 'aaleen

47.t: They argued, “Will we believe in two humans, like ourselves, whose people are slaves to us?”
47.tr: Faqaaloo annu'minu libasharaini mislinaa Wa-qawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon

48.t: So they rejected them both, and ˹so˺ were among those destroyed

49.t: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so perhaps his people would be ˹rightly˺ guided
49.tr: Wa-laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba la'allahum yahtadoon

50.t: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them refuge on high ground—a ˹suitable˺ place for rest with flowing water
50.tr: Wa-ja'alnab na Maryama Wa-ummahooo aayatannw Wa-aawainaahumaaa ilaa rabwatin zaati qaraarinw Wa-ma'een

51.t: O messengers! Eat from what is good and lawful, and act righteously. Indeed, I fully know what you do
51.tr: Yaaa-aiyuhar Rusulu kuloo minat taiyibaati wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona 'Aleem

52.t: Surely this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so fear Me ˹alone˺
52.tr: Wa-inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw Wa-Ana Rabbukum fattaqoon

53.t: Yet the people have divided it into different sects, each rejoicing in what they have
53.tr: Fataqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum zuburaa; kullu hizbim bimaa ladaihim farihoon

54.t: So leave them ˹O Prophet˺ in their heedlessness for a while

55.t: Do they think, since We provide them with wealth and children
55.tr: A-yahsaboona annnamaa numiduhum bihee mim maalinw Wa-baneen

56.t: that We hasten to ˹honour˺ them ˹with˺ all kinds of good? No! They are not aware
56.tr: Nusaari'u lahum fil khairaat; bal laa yash'uroon

57.t: Surely those who tremble in awe of their Lord
57.tr: Innal lazeena hum min khashyati Rabbihim mushfiqoon

58.t: and who believe in the revelations of their Lord

59.t: and who associate none with their Lord

60.t: and who do whatever ˹good˺ they do with their hearts fearful, ˹knowing˺ that they will return to their Lord—
60.tr: Wallazeena yu'toona maaa aataw Wa-quloobuhum wajilatun annahum ilaa Rabbihim raaji'oon

61.t: it is they who race to do good deeds, always taking the lead
61.tr: Ulaaa'ika yusaari'oona fil khairaati Wa-hum lahaa saabiqoon

62.t: We never require of any soul more than what it can afford. And with Us is a record which speaks the truth. None will be wronged
62.tr: Wa-laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa Wa-ladainaa kitaabuny yantiqu bilhaqqi Wa-ahum la yuzlamoon

63.t: But the hearts of those ˹who disbelieve˺ are oblivious to ˹all of˺ this, and they have other ˹evil˺ deeds, opposite to this, in which they are engrossed
63.tr: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratim min haazaa Wa-lahum a'maalum min dooni zaalika hum lahaa 'aamiloon

64.t: But as soon as We seize their elite with torment, they start to cry for help
64.tr: Hattaaa izaaa akhaznaa mutrafeehim bil'azaabi izaa hum yaj'aroon

65.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry for help today. Surely you will never be saved from Us
65.tr: Laa taj'arul yawma innakum minnaa laa tunsaroon

66.t: Indeed, My revelations were recited to you, but you used to back away ˹in disgust˺
66.tr: Qad kaanat Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum 'alaaa a'qaabikum tankisoon

67.t: boasting of the Sacred House, and babbling ˹nonsense about the Quran˺ by night.”

68.t: Is it because they have never contemplated the Word ˹of Allah˺? Or ˹because˺ there has come to them something that did not come to their forefathers
68.tr: Afalam yaddabbarrul qawla am jaaa'ahum maa lam yaati aabaaa'ahumul awwaleen

69.t: Or ˹because˺ they failed to recognize their Messenger, and so they denied him
69.tr: Am lam ya'rifoo Rasoolahum fahum lahoo munkiroon

70.t: Or ˹because˺ they say, “He is insane?” In fact, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are resentful of the truth
70.tr: Am yaqooloona bihee jinnnah; bal jaaa'ahum bilhaqqi Wa-aksaruhum lil-haqqi kaarihoon

71.t: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens, the earth, and all those in them would have certainly been corrupted. In fact, We have brought them ˹the means to˺ their glory, but they turn away from it
71.tr: Wa-lawit taba'al haqqu ahwaaa'ahum lafasadatis samaawaatu wal-ardu Wa-man feehinnn; bal atainaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mu'ridoon

72.t: Or ˹is it because˺ you ˹O Prophet˺ are asking them for tribute? But the reward of your Lord is best, for He is the Best Provider
72.tr: Am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju Rabbika khairunw Wa-Huwa khairur raaziqeen

73.t: And surely you are calling them to the Straight Path

74.t: but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are certainly deviating from that Path
74.tr: Wa-innnal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil-Aakhirati 'anis siraati lanaakiboon

75.t: ˹Even˺ if We had mercy on them and removed their affliction, they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly
75.tr: Wa-law rahimnaahum Wa-kashafnaa maa bihim min durril lalajjoo fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

76.t: And We have already seized them with torment, but they never humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they ˹submissively˺ appeal ˹to Him˺
76.tr: Wa-laqad akhaznaahum bil'azaabi famas takaanoo li-Rabbihim Wa-maa yatadarra'oon

77.t: But as soon as We open for them a gate of severe punishment, they will be utterly desperate
77.tr: Hattaaa izaa fatahnaa 'alaihim baaban zaa 'azaabin shadeedin izaa hum feehi mublisoon

78.t: He is the One Who created for you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks
78.tr: Wa-Huwal lazeee ansha-a lakumus sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idah; qaleelam maa tashkuroon

79.t: And He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered
79.tr: Wa-Huwal lazee zara-akum fil ardi Wa-ilaihi tuhsharoon

80.t: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of the day and night. Will you not then understand
80.tr: Wa-Huwal lazee yuhyee Wa-yumeetu Wa-lahukh tilaaful laili wannahaar; afalaa ta'qiloon

81.t: But they ˹just˺ say what their predecessors said
81.tr: Bal qaaloo misla maa qaalal awwaloon

82.t: They said, “Once we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
82.tr: Qaalooo 'a-izaa mitnaa Wa-kunnaa turaabanw Wa-'izaaman 'a-innaa lamab-'oosoon

83.t: We have already been promised this, as well as our forefathers earlier. This is nothing but ancient fables!”
83.tr: Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu Wa-aabaaa'unaa haazaa min qablu in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen

84.t: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “To whom belong the earth and all those on it, if you ˹really˺ know?”
84.tr: Qul limanil ardu Wa-man feehaaa in kuntum ta'lamoon

85.t: They will reply, “To Allah!” Say, “Why are you not then mindful?”

86.t: ˹And˺ ask ˹them˺, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”
86.tr: Qul mar Rabbus samaawaatis sab'i Wa-Rabbul 'Arshil 'Azeem

87.t: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

88.t: Ask ˹them also,˺ “In Whose Hands is the authority over all things, protecting ˹all˺ while none can protect against Him, if you ˹really˺ know?”
88.tr: Qul mam bi-yadihee malakootu kulli shai'inw Wa-Huwa yujeeru Wa-laa yujaaru 'alaihi in kuntum ta'lamoon

89.t: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “How are you then so deluded?”

90.t: In fact, We have brought them the truth, and they are certainly liars

91.t: Allah has never had ˹any˺ offspring, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he created, and they would have tried to dominate one another. Glorified is Allah above what they claim
91.tr: Mat takhazal laahu minw waladinw Wa-maa kaana ma'ahoo min ilaah; izal lazahaba kullu ilaahim bimaa khalaqa Wa-la'alaa ba'duhum 'alaa ba'd; Subhaannal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon

92.t: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen. Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺

93.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Should You show me what they are threatened with
93.tr: Qur Rabbi immmaa turiyannee maa yoo'adoon

94.t: then, my Lord, do not count me among the wrongdoing people.”
94.tr: Rabbi falaa taj'alnee fil qawmiz zaalimeen

95.t: We are indeed able to show you what We have threatened them with
95.tr: Wa-innaa 'alaaa an nuriyaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon

96.t: Respond to evil with what is best. We know well what they claim
96.tr: Idfa' billate hiya ahsanus saiyi'ah; nahnu a'lamu bimaa yasifoon

97.t: And say, “My Lord! I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils
97.tr: Wa-qur Rabbi a'oozu bika min hamazaatish Shayaateen

98.t: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, that they ˹even˺ come near me.”

99.t: When death approaches any of them, they cry, “My Lord! Let me go back
99.tr: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'a ahada-humul mawtu qaala Rabbir ji'oon

100.t: so I may do good in what I left behind.” Never! It is only a ˹useless˺ appeal they make. And there is a barrier behind them until the Day they are resurrected
100.tr: La'alleee a'malu saalihan feemaa taraktu kallaa; innahaa kalimatun huwa qaaa'iluhaa Wa-minw waraaa'ihim barzakhun ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

101.t: Then, when the Trumpet will be blown, there will be no kinship between them on that Day, nor will they ˹even care to˺ ask about one another
101.tr: Fa-izaa nufikha fis Soori falaaa ansaaba bainahum yawma'izinw Wa-laa yatasaaa'aloon

102.t: As for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, it is they who will be successful
102.tr: Faman saqulat mawaazee-nuhoo fa-ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon

103.t: But those whose scale is light, they will have doomed themselves, staying in Hell forever
103.tr: Wa-man khaffat mawaa-zeenuhoo fa-ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasiroo 'anfusahum fee Jahannama khaalidoon

104.t: The Fire will burn their faces, leaving them deformed
104.tr: Talfahu wujoohahumun Naaru Wa-hum feehaa kaalihoon

105.t: ˹It will be said,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, but you used to deny them?”
105.tr: Alam takun Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon

106.t: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people
106.tr: Qaaloo Rabbanaa ghalabat 'alainaa shiqwatunaa Wa-kunnaa qawman daaalleen

107.t: Our Lord! Take us out of this ˹Fire˺. Then if we ever return ˹to denial˺, we will truly be wrongdoers.”
107.tr: Rabbanaa akhrijnaa minhaa fa-in 'udnaa fa-innaa zaalimoon

108.t: Allah will respond, “Be despised in there! Do not ˹ever˺ plead with Me ˹again˺

109.t: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to pray, ‘Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy,’
109.tr: Innahoo kaana fareequm min 'ibaadee yaqooloona Rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa Wa-Anta khairur raahimeen

110.t: but you were ˹so busy˺ making fun of them that it made you forget My remembrance. And you used to laugh at them
110.tr: Fattakhaztumoohum sikhriyyan hattaaa ansawkum zikree Wa-kuntum minhum tadhakoon

111.t: Today I have indeed rewarded them for their perseverance: they are certainly the triumphant.”
111.tr: Inee jazaituhumul Yawma bimaa sabarooo annahum humul faaa'izoon

112.t: He will ask ˹them˺, “How many years did you remain on earth?”
112.tr: Qaala kam labistum fil ardi 'adada sineen

113.t: They will reply, “We remained ˹only˺ a day or part of a day. But ask those who kept count.”
113.tr: Qaaloo labisnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin fas'alil 'aaaddeen

114.t: He will say, “You only remained for a little while, if only you knew
114.tr: Qaala il labistum illaa qaleelal law annakum kuntum ta'lamoon

115.t: Did you then think that We had created you without purpose, and that you would never be returned to Us?”
115.tr: Afahsibtum annamaa khalaqnaakum 'abasanw Wa-annakum ilainaa laa turja'oon

116.t: Exalted is Allah, the True King! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Honourable Throne
116.tr: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Kareem

117.t: Whoever invokes, besides Allah, another god—for which they can have no proof—they will surely find their penalty with their Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed
117.tr: Wa-maien yad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara laa burhaana lahoo bihee fa-inna maa hisaabuhoo 'inda Rabbih; innahoo laa yuflihul kaafiroon

118.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”
118.tr: Wa-qul Rabbigh fir warham Wa-Anta khairur raahimeen
